graph_diagnosis.summary: Inflation surprises, tariff sentiment, and market rebounds provide a reusable equity-return framework.
weaknesses: Several claims infer Nasdaq effects from broader market moves.
Early outlook and earnings links are weakly causal.

search_factors.why_search: Inflation data can reprice rates and equity valuations.
Tariff uncertainty can drive risk sentiment and volatility.
Post-shock rebound determines the month's cumulative return.
Earnings can reinforce or weaken market risk appetite.

checkpoints.mechanism: Favorable inflation can support a relief rally.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Compare inflation release with consensus and rate repricing.

checkpoints.mechanism: Tariff uncertainty can amplify inflation sensitivity and volatility.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Track policy statements and tariff headlines.

checkpoints.mechanism: A rebound can offset earlier volatility in monthly returns.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Measure index recovery from the drawdown.

checkpoints.mechanism: Earnings can influence market breadth and risk appetite.
Inflation, policy sentiment, and rebounds combine into the monthly Nasdaq return.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Calculate the month-end index return and attribute major moves.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Nasdaq diverges from broader market catalysts.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Favorable inflation after tariff uncertainty can support a market rebound and monthly return.
Earnings sentiment can alter the breadth of the monthly equity move.

alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Compare market moves around tariff and inflation news.

forecast_audit_questions: Did the rebound persist into month-end?
